name: XLA_EVENT_TYPE_SOURCES
description: This table contains sources used by an event type in context of the application accounting definition it is assigned to.

columns.name: APPLICATION_ID
columns.description: Identifier of a functional area within a software suite of products. For example: Financials, or Payroll.

columns.name: JERS_CODE
columns.description: Code of the journal entry rule set.

columns.name: JERS_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Code of the type of the journal entry rule set. The possible values are: C: owned and defined by the user. S: owned and predefined by Oracle.

columns.name: AMB_CONTEXT_CODE
columns.description: Accounting method builder context.

columns.name: PRODUCT_RULE_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Indicates whether product rules are seeded.

columns.name: PRODUCT_RULE_CODE
columns.description: Short name of a product rule that contains effective accounting rules that are valid for a specific assignment date.

columns.name: ENTITY_CODE
columns.description: Unique abbreviated name assigned to an entity and used for reporting or in reference to an option.

columns.name: EVENT_CLASS_CODE
columns.description: Unique abbreviated name assigned to an event class and used for reporting or in reference to an option.

columns.name: EVENT_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Unique abbreviated name assigned to an event type and used for reporting or in reference to an option.

columns.name: SOURCE_ORIGIN_CODE
columns.description: Indicates whether the subledger source or formula is predefined.

columns.name: SOURCE_APPLICATION_ID
columns.description: Identifier of source application.

columns.name: SOURCE_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Indicates whether the source is seeded.

columns.name: SOURCE_CODE
columns.description: Short name of the transaction information that is used to create journal entries.

columns.name: SOURCE_LEVEL_CODE
columns.description: Indicates whether it is a header level source or line level source.

columns.name: SOURCE_DATA_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Abbreviated name that indicates the data type of the source. For examples, N (Numeric), C (Character), or D (Date).

columns.name: EXTRACT_OBJECT_NAME
columns.description: Transaction object that provides the source.

columns.name: EXTRACT_OBJECT_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Short name of a transaction object type.

columns.name: COLUMN_DATATYPE_CODE
columns.description: Data type of the column in a transaction object

columns.name: COLUMN_WIDTH
columns.description: Width of the column in transaction object.

columns.name: REFERENCE_OBJECT_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether the source is from reference object.

columns.name: ALWAYS_POPULATED_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates if source will always return a value.

columns.name: JOIN_CONDITION
columns.description: Condition that joins the transaction and reference objects.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: JOB_DEFINITION_NAME
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the name of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: JOB_DEFINITION_PACKAGE
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the package name of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: EDITION_NAME
columns.description: Identifier of the currently active event type sources.
